fields.contract_details: General Practice (GP) Managed Print Services. The current fleet is approximately 7,800 devices, the majority of which require a solution based on USB connectivity. Procurement to cover the following themes: - Print Hardware and Installation, - Print Consumables, - Training and Documentation for Practices, - Management of Print Assets and Print Availability (Break/Fix Services), - Provision of Print Activity Reporting and Analytics, including reporting by media type at enterprise, site, and device level, to support operational management, cost transparency, and sustainability objectives
